relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF binds the TrkA receptor, which is found in peptidergic C fibers and Aδ fibers

relationships.subject: local translation
relationships.evidence_quote: local protein synthesis has been implicated in the establishment of hyperalgesic priming

relationships.subject: metformin
relationships.evidence_quote: metformin, an AMPK activator, which acts upstream of mTOR, corrects abnormal mRNA translation and reverses enhanced neuronal excitability and behavioral hypersensitivity in several models of chronic pain

key_findings: Review: local (axonal) translation in primary afferents contributes to sensitization and the transition from acute to chronic pain.
mTOR and eIF4E (metformin, eFT508) are proposed therapeutic convergence points.
